categories.evidence: Changes doc/i2p.md (+7/-1) to document I2P transient destination behavior.
categories.rationale: Clarifies inaccurate privacy documentation regarding I2P network footprint. doc/i2p.md previously stated that persistent I2P addresses are used for all outbound connections without noting the exception that '-privatebroadcast forces the use of a new transient destination for each transaction it relays.'
